messages:
alerts-bot: 🔔 ALERT: inference.p99_latency > 2.5s for 6m on prod (streaming tails). Service: inference-gateway. Affected regions: eu-west-1, us-east-1. Auto-paging to on-call.
sam: @maya @jia I'm on-call, looking now. seeing a ton of tail latency alerts in the dashboard. Paging SREs and infra.
maya: digging into traces — lots of long waits in the inference path waiting for configfetch/auth. p95 ~ 420ms, p99 ~ 2.6s for streaming responses. Many traces show downstream 503/504s from configstore DB.
jia: confirmed increased 5xx from auth-proxy and rate-limit 429s timestamp-aligned. Here's the recent error summary:
```
auth-proxy: 5xx spikes -> 120/s
rate-limiter: 429s -> 80/s
configstore-db: connection queue depth high, avg wait 350ms
```
leo: can we do a graceful fallback to a stateless model variant (model-compact-v2) for streaming to reduce dependency on configfetch? That would lower tail while we mitigate DB.
tanvi: CS: we're getting multiple customer reports of audio streaming stalls and websocket disconnects. Early estimate ~1.4% of active requests experiencing stalls/timeouts in EU. Notified top 5 enterprise customers.
maya: Mitigation plan (short):
1) throttle non-critical configfetch calls (feature flags/experiments) at gateway
2) bump auth token cache TTL and enable in-memory cache on auth-proxy
3) trigger routing fallback to model-compact-v2 for streaming for affected regions
4) scale configstore DB replicas and increase connection pool temporarily
I'll start #1 & #2 now.
jia: applied temporary rate-limit relax on auth-proxy -> increased token cache TTL. Patch:
```
# deployed via k8s configmap
token_cache_ttl: 1800  # seconds
auth_proxy_retries: 2
```
watching for regressions.
deploy-bot: canary deploy: auth-cache-ttl bump rolled to 2/6 pods in eu-west-1 — health checks OK.
sam: good. @leo please prepare routing change for fallback; start gradual rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) and stick to 5m step intervals unless metrics worsen.
leo: starting rollout now. updating routing policy:
```
route-policy streaming: model-> fallback model-compact-v2
stage: 10%
steps: 5m
```
leo: (after 5m) moving to 50%.
maya: observing metrics: after cache bump + 50% fallback, p99 dropped from 2.6s -> 1.1s; p95 stable ~420ms. Streaming stall reports reduced by ~65%. Tail still ~900ms in worst buckets.
jia: noticed configstore connection pool saturation; increased pool size and restarted pods rolling (configstore replicas scaled from 3 -> 5, pool_size 50 -> 120). Command used:
```
kubectl apply -f configstore-deployment-pool-bump.yaml
kubectl rollout status deploy/configstore -n platform
```
ops-bot: PagerDuty PD-7890 created for this incident. Conference bridge started: +1-555-0100 pin 4321.
tanvi: customer-impact note: approx 1.2% of requests experienced errors/timeouts during peak; eu-west-1 worst. CS notified enterprise accounts; prep message template sent to account teams. Severity: Sev2 (customer-visible degradation, partial mitigation in place).
amy (from CS): FYI, a customer in EU reported a 30s stall; we prioritized follow-up for that tenant.
sam: on-call handoff: I'll be handing to @alex at 06:00 UTC. @maya will continue immediate mitigation and hand details to alex. Current status: fallback 50% -> 85% to reduce tail further; retries disabled on non-idempotent streaming.
alex: ack taking handoff at 06:00 UTC. Please paste runbook link and key traces. I'll keep watch overnight.
maya: saving artifacts to incident channel and S3:
- traces: trace-abc123, trace-def456
- logs: s3://redwood-incident-logs/1718894321/
- perf snapshot: p95/p99 graphs uploaded
maya: next steps for postmortem: validate configstore connection pooling defaults, add circuit-breaker in configfetch path, improve token cache fallback behavior, add automated rollback on p99 > threshold. Assign owners and timeline post-incident.
sam: thanks everyone. current last check: p99 ~750ms, errors trending down. Will update PD and incident record with mitigation timeline.
ops-bot: incident annotated: mitigations applied: auth-cache-ttl bump, routing fallback to model-compact-v2, configstore pool bump. Close if stable >30m.
sam: handing off to alex now. If anything spikes, @pager oncall escalate to infra-sre.
alex: taking over. I'll follow up with a short postmortem draft tomorrow. :thumbsup:
